text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp is here! The perfect 
time for intensive training—and while some 
students are on edge—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser remained as bright and 
carefree as ever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Carrying the girl who could remain 
ordinary no matter the occasion, the bus 
slowly rolled toward the training camp 
grounds.
